channel.title: SCP-IDEA A multidimensional book about records
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "SCP-IDEA A multidimensional book about records" - A book containing all the records

item.title: Re: SCP-IDEA A multidimensional book about records
item.content:encoded:
First and foremost thank you for the criticism. I am glad that the idea itself is enough to warrant a greenlight. I simply did not ask for greenlights, since I am not entirely sure about the concept itself. While I wanted to write about records, I was not sure which path to take. From the book "preserving" the record holder inside of it to the current setting.

These details need to be figured out before I go a step further.

My aim for this version is to highlight the struggle of the SCP-foundation to discover relevant information inside of the book. The junior researcher element was more of a subtle development, which would take place as the story progresses.

The first part is comedic in nature and the second part is for the elements of horror. I want to showcase, that an object does not need to be inherently dangerous or capable of manipulating humans left and right in order to cause a human to commit horrendous deeds, something one is quick to forget.

item.title: Re: SCP-IDEA A multidimensional book about records
item.content:encoded:
It's cute, if bland. Honestly, it seems like an attempt to get some throwback to Series 1 levels of narrative, similar to 1004.

Frankly, it baffles me how your elevator pitch is literally tangential to your central narrative, but whatever. The researcher acting that way makes sense - seeing so many other beings having been memorialized is gonna fucking give anyone an inferiority complex. As it stands, it'll really depend on your execution to make things right.

I know you said you're not looking for greenlights, but seeing as you need two greenlights to move onto the Drafts forum, consider this your first greenlight should you need to use it.

item.title: SCP-IDEA A multidimensional book about records
item.content:encoded:
A book containing all the records set by any entity in any dimension in all of existence.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article,

Genre: Drama/Emotional, Comedy,

Page Layout: Standard

Elevator Pitch: The vehement struggle of the Foundation to obtain useful information out of the book amongst the limitless amount of entries inside of it.

Central Narrative: Besides the SCP- foundation trying to seek out useful knowledge, I want to have a young scientist try to immortalize him or herself inside this book. After several failed attempts the person starts to get more and more desperate and obsessive about achieving "eternal fame and recognition" for their deeds. A slow descent into madness and a loss of morals follow. The book itself has no other anomalous qualities then depicting the records.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: I think that the premise, of a record book in a world full of extremes, is an interesting idea and something which would draw a lot of attention, provided it is done in a sufficient manner. Many parallels to existing SCPs could be drawn as well.
